body:
Leah (Support): quick flag — our EE customer reported answers sounding 'oddly rehearsed' after yesterday's model push. examples attached, short thread.
Arjun (ML Eng): can you paste a before/after snippet? and which model id did they hit?
Leah (Support): customer says before: friendlier cadence, slight elaboration. after: same content but more repeated signposting, e.g., 'First, ... Second, ... Finally...' and extra filler like 'to be clear' inserted. they sent two convo examples.
Leah (Support): customer example — BEFORE:
```
User: How do I reset my API key?
Assistant: To reset your API key, go to Settings → API keys, click regenerate, and update any saved integrations. Want me to open the docs link?
```
Leah (Support): customer example — AFTER:
```
User: How do I reset my API key?
Assistant: First, to be clear, you should navigate to Settings, and then go to API keys. Second, click regenerate. Finally, ensure you update the integrations that rely on it. Do you want the docs link? Just to confirm.
```
Leah (Support): they called this a 'paced, scripted rhythm' — not shorter, just different cadence. they attached single API call showing model: "rwd-v10" and rollout timestamp 3129800000.
Arjun (ML Eng): interesting. not a verbosity drop, more of a discourse marker increase. could be a decoding/penalty/regression in repetition handling or a tiny prompt-template drift at the routing layer.
Marta (DevEx): cc @Arjun — any known changes to system/preamble or default generation config in the canary -> prod rollout window around 3129800000? I can grep deploy logs.
deploy-bot: canary deploy rwd-v10 -> prod completed 2024-12-15T03:20:12Z (id: canary-20241215-17)
Arjun (ML Eng): thanks. I did a quick diff: temperature unchanged, but we enabled a new discourse-normalization postprocessor on canary to reduce hallucinations. could that add explicit connectors? I'll test.
Arjun (ML Eng): repro steps I'm running: 1) same user prompt 2) model rwd-v10 3) deterministic seeds off 4) with/without postprocessor. will post outputs.
Leah (Support): customer wants either rollback or mitigation; they hit it in a support flow where cadence matters. priority high.
Marta (DevEx): quick mitigation idea: route that customer's org to rwd-v9 pinned model until we confirm. support can add org override. Leah can you collect org id and examples? also include the exact API request headers so we can reproduce region/routing.
Leah (Support): org id 98765. attaching original curl they used:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-..." \ 
  -d '{"model":"rwd-v10","input":"How do I reset my API key?","max_tokens":120}'
```
Arjun (ML Eng): thanks. early tests look promising: with postprocessor ON we get the extra signposting; with it OFF outputs match prior cadence. I suspect the postprocessor inserts discourse markers to improve clarity but it's overapplied.
Arjun (ML Eng): next steps: 1) short-term - rollback postprocessor for prod or gated by profile; 2) medium - tune postprocessor heuristics; 3) notify Eval team to add prompt-based checks for discourse marker drift.
Marta (DevEx): I'll open a policy change to pin org 98765 to rwd-v9 and add a note in console routing. Leah please confirm with customer once pinned.
Leah (Support): pinged customer, they're ok with temporary pin. also asked for more examples. thanks team :thumbsup:
Arjun (ML Eng): logging this as EXPLAIN-312987 — will follow up with repro artifacts and diffed outputs.
Marta (DevEx): added routing override and created a short KB entry for Support: "How to pin org to previous model version".
Leah (Support): closing loop with customer now. will post any additional examples if they see more strange phrasing.
